# Tumblr

> Tumblr is a social blogging platform and community where users share, discover, and engage with diverse content across multiple formats.

Tumblr is a microblogging and social networking platform owned by Automattic that allows users to create blogs, share multimedia content, and build communities around shared interests. The platform is accessible via web and mobile apps across iOS, Android, and browser extensions.

## Key Topics

- Blogging Platform
- Social Network
- Community Culture
- Mobile Apps
- iOS
- Android
- Browser Extension
- User-Generated Content
- Brand Identity
- Privacy Policy
- Terms of Service
- Automattic
- San Francisco
- Personalized Ads
- User Testimonials

## Getting Started

- [About Tumblr](https://www.tumblr.com/about): Company overview of Tumblr blogging platform and community culture
- [Get the Apps](https://www.tumblr.com/apps): Download Tumblr apps for iPhone, iPad, Android, Chrome, Firefox

## Support & Documentation

- [Tumblr Help Center](https://www.tumblr.com/help): Help center with documentation, guides, and support resources
- [Your Advertising Choices](https://help.tumblr.com/hc/articles/360041012973-Your-Advertising-Choices): Guide to advertising choices, privacy settings, and personalized ads

## Legal & Privacy

- [Terms of Service](https://www.tumblr.com/policy/terms-of-service): Terms of service and legal agreement for Tumblr platform
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.tumblr.com/policy/privacy): Privacy policy with GDPR and data protection information
- [Privacy Information](https://www.tumblr.com/privacy/en): Privacy policy covering data collection and handling practices
